paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Bechukotai 7, and in Pesikta Rabbati, section "Vayehi bachatzi halailah," and in Yalkut, Judges, remez 66.[^1]

notes.text: בחקתי־ז is Bechukotai 7; פס׳ רבתי is contextually Pesikta Rabbati, with פ׳ the named section Vayehi bachatzi halailah; סו gives remez 66. These are Hyman’s locators without independent edition verification. The earlier modern Pesikta 17 suggestion is not adopted. The personal-title abbreviation remains R'.
